visual_language.medium: Diagrammatic geological cross-section illustration: matte mineral-color fields, granular particulate marks, translucent atmospheric washes, and sparse luminous event accents.
visual_language.surface: The image behaves like a freshly cut rock face or core sample on a deep matte ground: bands, grains, veins, fractures, and inclusions remain materially legible rather than smoothed into generic scenery.
visual_language.mark_making: Layering, bedding, particulate drift, offset blocks, plume-like fields, contour seams, and mineral veins; repeated geological process marks carry more meaning than decorative brush flourish.
visual_language.signature_accent: One concentrated seam, horizon, crystal, thermal glow, or mineral event may carry vivid luminous color against otherwise earthbound massing.
visual_language.finish: Scientific plate meets geological sublime: process-first, tactile and diagrammatically legible at card scale, with enough atmosphere to feel planetary without becoming photorealistic landscape art.
avoid: decorative crystals unrelated to the depicted process
smooth gradients that erase bedding, grain, fracture, or contact geometry
uniform texture that makes the four geological process families indistinguishable
